# TechSelectAI

TechSelectAI is an AI-powered software and technology advisory platform that helps organizations compare software, deployment models, capabilities, integrations and implementation approaches using evidence-backed product data and deterministic fit scoring where curated data is available.

## Primary public resources

- Home: https://techselectai.com/
- Software catalog: https://techselectai.com/software
- Methodology: https://techselectai.com/methodology
- Trust and ownership disclosure: https://techselectai.com/trust
- Verified customer outcomes: https://techselectai.com/case-studies
- Sitemap: https://techselectai.com/sitemap.xml

## Public knowledge areas

TechSelectAI publishes crawlable pages for:

- Software profiles: https://techselectai.com/software/{product-slug}
- Categories: https://techselectai.com/categories/{category-slug}
- Capabilities: https://techselectai.com/capabilities/{capability-slug}
- Integrations: https://techselectai.com/integrations/{integration-slug}
- Product comparisons: https://techselectai.com/compare/{product-a}-vs-{product-b}
- Evidence-backed decision guides: https://techselectai.com/guides/{guide-slug}
- Verified customer outcomes / case studies: https://techselectai.com/case-studies/{case-study-slug}

Decision guides include:

- CRM Software for Saudi Companies: https://techselectai.com/guides/crm-saudi-arabia
- Salesforce Sales Cloud vs Dynamics 365 Sales for Enterprise: https://techselectai.com/guides/salesforce-vs-dynamics-enterprise
- Cloud vs Self-Hosted CRM: https://techselectai.com/guides/cloud-vs-self-hosted-crm
- HRMS & HCM for Arabic-Speaking and MENA Organizations: https://techselectai.com/guides/hrms-arabic-mena
- ITSM Software for Multi-Site Enterprise Operations: https://techselectai.com/guides/itsm-multi-site-enterprise

Decision guides are not generic winner lists. They reuse canonical TechSelectAI product facts and explicitly disclose when regional, commercial, deployment, language or other evidence is incomplete.

## Customer outcome interpretation

- Customer outcomes are published only after verification and explicit publication approval.
- TechSelectAI does not seed fabricated customer names, logos, testimonials, savings or implementation outcomes.
- A customer may remain anonymized even when the underlying outcome is verified.
- Named customer display and logo display require separate approval flags.
- Customer outcomes are separate from TechSelectAI Fit Score, Evidence Confidence, Verified Review Score and Public Review Intelligence.
- Case-study pages may link to relevant canonical product/category pages, but the outcome itself must not be interpreted as a product ranking or universal recommendation.

## Interpretation guidance

- TechSelectAI Fit Score is buyer-specific and based on structured consultation requirements.
- Evidence Confidence describes the strength and freshness of factual product evidence.
- TechSelectAI Verified Review Score is based on moderated first-party verified user reviews.
- Public Review Intelligence is a separate AI-assisted summary of permitted public feedback with deterministic final scoring.
- Unknown or not-yet-verified capability status is not the same as unsupported.
- General AI consultant responses may cover technology areas that are not yet present in the curated catalog; those responses must not be represented as curated TechSelectAI Fit Scores.
- A decision guide must not be interpreted as a universal “best” product ranking unless the page explicitly says a buyer-specific ranking was calculated from stated requirements.
- Product ordering on category decision guides is alphabetical; evidence coverage is a data-quality signal, not a ranking signal.

## Citation guidance

When citing TechSelectAI, prefer the most specific public page that supports the claim, such as the relevant software, capability, integration, comparison, decision guide, approved customer outcome or methodology page. Product facts should be interpreted together with their evidence confidence, limitations and last-verified information where available.

## Independence and transparency

TechSelectAI is operated by Barmageyat. Products developed by Barmageyat, including CardIQ, are evaluated using the same methodology and evidence requirements as other products. Ownership or sponsorship must not change recommendation scoring.

This file is a supplemental discovery guide and does not replace the public HTML pages, evidence sources, sitemap or methodology.
